title: hypericum mutilum f. minus
intro: Hypericum mutilum f. minus, commonly known as Dwarf St. John's Wort, is a small, flowering plant belonging to the St. John's Wort family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf St. John's Wort include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Dwarf St. John's Wort may also contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating effects.
